// diagnostic E0305

Jet.PatternTypeMismatch

Pattern doesn't belong to value's type

What

Pattern doesn't belong to value's type

Why

A pattern can only test a value of the type it describes

Fix

Make the pattern's shape and types match the value.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.PatternTypeMismatch: Tests/UI/enum_cases_no_unit_collapse.stderr.

Error: Jet.ReturnTypeMismatch: This value is `Unit`, but `absent_as_unit` returns Int?
  --> Tests/UI/enum_cases_no_unit_collapse.jet:13:32
    |
 13 | absent_as_unit: fn() -> Int? { () }
    |                                ^^
 Why: `absent_as_unit` declares Int? as its result, so the value it hands back must be Int?
 Fix: Hand back a Int? value: convert this value to Int?, or return the value you meant
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.ReturnTypeMismatch

Error: Jet.UntypedNone: Bare `None` needs a known optional type here
  --> Tests/UI/enum_cases_no_unit_collapse.jet:15:32
    |
 15 | shut_as_absent: fn() -> Gate { None }
    |                                ^^^^
 Why: `None` only fits where a `T?` is expected (S32)
 Fix: Write the optional type on the value, `T?{None}`, or use `None` where a `T?` is already expected
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.UntypedNone

Error: Jet.PatternTypeMismatch: Pattern `None` doesn't belong to `Int | Unit`
  --> Tests/UI/enum_cases_no_unit_collapse.jet:19:9
    |
 19 |         .None -> "nothing"
    |         ^^^^^
 Why: Union pattern arms name one member type of the subject union
 Fix: Use one of the subject union member types
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.PatternTypeMismatch

Error: Jet.PatternTypeMismatch: Pattern `Shut` doesn't match `Gate?`
  --> Tests/UI/enum_cases_no_unit_collapse.jet:24:51
    |
 24 | absent_as_shut: fn(gate: Gate?) -> Bool { gate == .Shut }
    |                                                   ^^^^^
 Why: Variant patterns only work on enum values
 Fix: Match a value with a pattern for its type
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.PatternTypeMismatch
